name: obsidian-wiki
description: Skills that keep a personal Obsidian vault tidy: save, ingest, lint and query notes

plugins.name: wiki-save
plugins.description: Save a useful answer from the conversation as a draft note in the Inbox of my Obsidian vault

plugins.name: wiki-query
plugins.description: Answer questions from my Obsidian vault with [[Note]] citations, plus read-only lookups by name, tag, topic and status
